text:
maria: Heads-up — I need to press prod deploy at 15:30 PT in the 18:00 UTC change window. Quick check: who currently has deploy perms? MFA enrollment shows 3 SREs missing. If they can't be staged, can we create a temp svcacct grant? @security please advise. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: Release E2.3.7 queued. Requires one deployer to claim with MFA. Current deployers registered: maria, raj, alex. Claim with `/deploy claim --release E2.3.7` or use the svcacct fallthrough with explicit approval.

raj: I can claim but MFA is failing for me on my new phone — getting `MFA token invalid`. Tried re-sync, no luck.

alex: Same problem after re-enroll. If we can't fix MFA in time, can we use svc-deployer-temp for a one-off?

sre-oncall: We have an existing temp svcacct `svc-deployer-temp@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with 1h TTL in the jumpbox. It requires 2 approvers + security exception. Who can sign off?

security: We can approve an exception but need the audit trail. Minimal checklist to approve: 1) brief reason 2) TTL (<=60m) 3) exact commands the svcacct will run 4) 2 approvers from eng teams. Post the request to #incidents and include INC ticket. No permanent bypass.

maria: I'll open the incident ticket now and tag approvers. Proposed approvers: @raj + @sam. TTL 60m. Reason: urgent prod push to fix leaderboard flakiness in E2.3.7 canary.

sam: Ack, will approve once ticket is up. Also please pin the release image in the notes to avoid drift: `model-serving:7.4.1` pinned.

kevin: Quick ops note — if we use svcacct ensure CI uses `--impersonate-service-account` rather than storing keys, and do not run `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` for long-lived keys. Example one-liner: ```gcloud auth activate-service-account svc-deployer-temp@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com --key-file=/tmp/temp-key.json && kubectl apply -f release.yaml``` Replace with impersonation in CI.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll claim after security approves. If not approved by 15:20 PT we hold and fall back to rollback plan B (push pinned image v7.4.0).

deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollback scheduled if no active claim by 15:25 PT — rollback target v7.4.0. Use `/deploy cancel` to stop rollback when claim is active.

sre-oncall: Ticket INC-4829 created in #incidents. Security approved exception with comment: "exception granted for 60m with full audit". Approvers: sam, raj. Initiating temp svcacct grant now.

maria: Claimed and pressed deploy. Canary passing ✅. Monitoring logs and will update release notes with pinned image + changelog. Thanks everyone for fast approvals.
